provenance.method: Local native Microsoft PowerPoint captures with one text shape per control; assigned font/size/weight/frame/text/paragraph settings matched to the source-pinned manifests.
provenance.text_normalization: Preserved manifests use LF delimiters; PowerPoint text/paragraphs use CR. Comparison normalizes LF to CR; the original manifest bytes remain unchanged.
provenance.first_baseline: First PDF text-show baseline minus the matched native shape-frame top, in points. Origins match controls by slide and native shape index, with exactly two PDF origins per control.
provenance.terminal_character_height: Max bottom minus min top for non-whitespace native character bounds on the last visible line. CR bounds are excluded.
provenance.observed_leading: Second visible-line top minus first visible-line top from native non-whitespace character bounds. The original exact style.leading remains the calibration key.

rounding_and_observed_variation.native_character_line_positions: Native visible positions align to a quarter-point grid within 0.000016 pt; observed pitch can differ from requested paragraph leading and is recorded for every control.
rounding_and_observed_variation.native_readback: Additional56 fractional size/leading values round to the nearest 0.01 pt (max delta 0.004445 pt); original250 paragraph readbacks differ only by binary float noise (<=0.000001 pt).
rounding_and_observed_variation.pdf_baselines: PDF show-origin baseline values are at 0.01 pt precision and agree with native visible pitch within 0.25 pt for every control.
rounding_and_observed_variation.pdf_font_size: PDF font size is not used to validate native font identity. Original250 reports sizes within 0.01 pt; Additional56 reports rounded/scaled size on 28 controls, differing up to 0.5 pt.
rounding_and_observed_variation.requested_key: Exact style.leading from each original source manifest is stored as leading_pt; observed native line pitch is a separate field.

provenance.font_identity_limit: Native shape, paragraph, and character font names and bold/italic assignments match the source manifest; font bytes are pinned by source SHA. Included post-capture CoreText evidence reports competing static/variable installed faces and native_file_identity_verified:false. No exact installed-file resolution or before/after stability claim is made.
